target_customer: Companies subject to GDPR and CCPA needing privacy compliance tooling
problem: Companies could not easily find and track personal data across systems to meet GDPR and CCPA obligations.
business_model: Software deployable on-premises or in cloud (AWS, Azure) for privacy compliance; pricing not found

founders.name: Heather Wade
founders.background_notes: Led engineering teams, worked on GDPR readiness (GeekWire via search summary).

founders.name: John Wade
founders.background_notes: Handles marketing per TechCrunch via search summary; married to Heather.

technical_complexity.rationale: Data discovery and classification across enterprise systems with ML, deployed on-prem, is non-trivial but standard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: No evidence of data or regulatory moat; many privacy vendors existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source gathered on incumbent action; the cause of inactivity is not public.

market_need_then: GDPR took effect in May 2018 and CCPA in 2020, creating compliance demand cited in 2019 coverage (TechCrunch, GeekWire).

branding.domain_note: Used preclus.io, a .io domain rather than an exact .com.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand, community or recognition found; website unreachable (503) at check time.

outcome_analysis: Preclusio, a two-person GDPR and CCPA compliance startup from YC Summer 2019, is listed Inactive. No shutdown notice, post-mortem or acquisition report was found, so the cause is not public. The team was tiny, the field crowded and funding is undocumented, but those are context, not sourced causes, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Cause of inactivity not public. Funding: only a Diffbot-derived $150K pre-seed (Y Combinator, Liquid 2 Ventures) on employbl.com; unverified, not recorded.
